not upstream: upstream has no profile-edit API, so the request follows the account.bilibili.com profile page and has no fixture comparison. Renaming costs 6 coins each time (free once for an account that never set a nickname) and needs confirming; the signature is at most 70 characters and is reviewed after the change; avatars accept png / jpg only, at most 2 MB
show time, venue, price tier and sale state are written into text; --tickets needs a session
--type video uses the video channel search, anything else uses the general channel; --type image returns image posts only
first page only (m.weibo.cn's guest asks for a session from page two on)

uses the results of the first related search term
returns the works preview from the publish page (work_list); a scheduled unpublished work has status draft
videos uploaded to your own channel, from YouTube Studio
the media URL comes from the video detail (video.playAddr; imagePost for image posts); upstream has no separate resolve API
best video track plus audio track, split. Uses the VISIONOS client without a session; too many requests from one egress IP trigger a bot check; age-restricted and similar videos get no URL
the media URL is the same as item media
downloads the item media video track and audio track as two files, without muxing

the torrent file carries the personal passkey and is written 0600; the temporary download URL is not printed. --qbit pushes to the local qBittorrent Web UI (CATBUS_MTEAM_QBIT_URL, default http://127.0.0.1:25254) and --qbit-savepath sets the save directory
no --cover, --mention, --poi, --category or --price; --image takes 1–31 images (15 MB each) and excludes --video
bodies over 280 weight post as a long post (needs Premium); --thread posts a thread

goes through YouTube Studio: chunked upload, and creating a video requires a BotGuard check, so local Chromium is needed (see AGENTS 5.7). The account needs a channel first; --schedule creates it private and flips it public at the time. Video upload is verified on a real machine. --cover requires the channel's custom-thumbnail feature (phone verification) and errors before upload when it is off
needs a captcha (Geetest click-to-select) that catbus cannot pass automatically; reports RISK_CONTROL
own videos only; also needs local Chromium for the BotGuard check
the upstream product API returns detail images, specs and a jump link only: title, image and price, with the other fields empty
supports videos, articles, text / repost dynamics and image dynamics; image dynamics get the album comment-section id from a non-upstream dynamic detail API, with no fixture comparison
first page only; --limit N takes N comments in one request

not upstream: the nested-reply and dynamic-detail APIs, with no fixture comparison; covers visible replies under video, article and image-dynamic root comments; nested replies for text and repost dynamics are not verified and unsupported
the upstream nested-comment API was checked against one captured parameter set only; results for other comments were not checked upstream
<comment> is a root comment id; YouTube replies are one level deep
dynamics support text and repost only: image dynamics (with images) hang their comment section on an album and upstream has no album-id API; videos and articles are unaffected
--reply-to takes a root comment or a reply; all replies hang under the root
dynamics support text and repost only: image dynamics (with images) hang their comment section on an album and upstream has no album-id API; videos and articles are unaffected

following is not upstream: upstream has no feed API, so the request follows the web dynamic page (x/polymer/web-dynamic/v1/feed/all) with no fixture comparison; lists videos from people you follow and needs a session
home recommendations and the subscription feed; the guest home is empty, so a session is needed
returns every hot show in that city at once, unpaged; --category filters locally
includes groups; a group conversation id is group:<group id>
inbox first page only (last 20 conversations); upstream has no paging
read-only and needs a password session; --box picks inbox / system / sent
direct chats take the peer id, groups take group:<group id>
messages are end-to-end encrypted, so only placeholder messages are emitted
<conversation> is an id from msg list; it is not marked read
text only, and only to a user with an existing conversation (upstream cannot open one)
without --item, --to opens the conversation on the upstream hard-coded default item; with --item, --to contacts that user about that item (a seller can reach a buyer)
--item contacts the product seller and --conversation replies into an existing conversation; --to is unsupported (there is no API to open a conversation by user)
lists public collections only (upstream has that one API); upstream has no items-in-collection API
lists only collections the user created, all in one response
